description: Long-form technical essay in Chinese or English. Carry one throughline, define each concept before its mechanism, and land on a concrete example whenever the text has stayed abstract.

rules.instruction: The whole piece can state in one sentence "what this article makes the reader understand"; every H2 serves that line.
Every new term is defined in plain language before first use; the first occurrence is bolded or given an inline definition.
After more than two consecutive paragraphs of abstraction, the text must land on a concrete example (code, data, incident, scenario).
Every figure is referenced in the body ("see Figure N") and has a self-contained caption — legible even when screenshotted alone.
Performance / cost / risk claims carry conditions and magnitudes; no bare assertions.
